notes.title: Event Announcement:
notes.content:
May Day holiday is coming, and there are many welfare activities in the sea area waiting for you!
The specific activity description is as follows:

1. Online rewards
Coordinate: Base Logistics Station
[Time]: May 1st to May 3rd, lasting for 3 days
[Description]: If the accumulated online time reaches the specified duration every day, you can receive online rewards
Even if you hang up, you can receive a soft touch. Commander, come here for free!

2. Recharge activity ①
（Coordinates ）:Off shore - Beside the capital city
[Time]: April 28th to May 5th, lasting for 8 days
[Description]: Accumulated recharge during the event period, with additional gifts of over a large amount of gold coins

3. Recharge activity ②
[Coordinates]: Offshore - Capital
[Time]: April 30th to May 4th, lasting for 5 days
(Description ): During the event, if the accumulated recharge meets the standard, a rare commander gift package and an A-level B-level rare skill gift package will be given as a gift
PS: The above two recharge activities have a high overlap in time, and can be stacked to receive rewards~

4. TapTap check-in activity
Activity link: https://www.taptap.cn/events/game-sign/ofx6j3w2
[Sign-in time]: April 29th to May 7th
(Redemption Time ): Redemption is available before 23:59:59 on May 7th
(Activity Description ): You can receive a welfare gift code for daily check-in, and there are also optional UR ship drawings after signing for 7 days
Unprecedented activity intensity, don't miss it~

notes.title: periodic update
notes.content:
1. Improve software performance.
2. Fix fragmented bugs.

notes.title: New Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. Fix bugs where the core making interface is stuck.

2. Fix a bug where Lucas' talent skills cannot take effect.

3. Fix the bug where the queue on the right will shrink to 4 teams during prolonged (3-5 minutes) viewing on the big map.

4. Fix other minor bugs.

notes.title: New Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
newly added:
1. New play method: daily sea battle.

Adjustment:
1. SSR and above commanders will not be inherited.
2. When opening the server list, it will automatically locate the corresponding group according to the login history.
3. If there is no reward available for signing in every day, it will not pop up on that day.
4. Optimize the main interface resource layout.

Repair:
1. The consumption and acquisition details of the hang up will be displayed completely.
2. Repair the problem of clicking and reporting errors on ship drawings.
3. Improve server stability.
4. Improve the game startup speed.
5. Repair of fragmentary bugs.

notes.title: New Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Adjustment:
1. The commander can load ships whose quality is limited by his own quality and is compatible downward.
2. The quality of skills that commanders can carry is limited by their own quality and is compatible downward:
2.1 UR=Class S, SSR=Class A, SR=Class B, R/N=Class C.
3. Theater privileges:
3.1 The commander can load UR ships, and the quality of the commander can load ships is improved by 1 level.
3.2. The quality of ships that can be carried by privileged commanders is increased by 2 levels.
3.3. Add a privileged commander to increase the skill quality by 1 level.
4. Adjust the charge and discount of treasure hunt.
5. Adjust the bonus effect of national spirit.
6. Increase the periodic report reward of daily report, and the following rounds of reports can be given rare commander fragments.
7. The operation mode of material synthesis is adjusted from selecting raw materials for synthesis to selecting synthetic products.
8. Adjust the strength of urban defense forces in each theater.
9. Adjust the names of some Shenzhou ships.
10. [Legendary Military Port] The opening condition is changed to 30 ships.

newly added:
11. Ship atlas: 003 (Shenzhou), Ford (Citi).
12. Skip plot button added in novice stage.
13. Personal information location displays the current theater.
14. Screen direction locking function in personal information settings.
15. System guidance when synthesis, drawing decomposition, equipment and other functions are unlocked.
16. "View Details" on the big map island to observe the troops stationed on the island.
17. Display of supplementary version number on the login interface.
18. Add logout button in service selection interface.
19. Ranks: Brigadier General, Major General.
20. When a player releases a national announcement, players from the same faction will see a dedicated pop-up window.

Optimization and repair:
21. The character color will change when the number of resources is too low.
22. When time limited resource activities occur, they will appear in the resource path.
23. Optimize the zoom experience of big map.
24. Optimize the prompt of troops arriving at the island, and increase the prompt tone.
25. Optimize the model performance of training ship in combat.
26. Optimize the commander's restraint performance in the campaign mode.
27. Fix the bug that multiple players can't issue their own lords' orders.
28. Fix the bug of the Lord's command icon.
29. Fix the bug that the commander can't open the battle on Ka Island occasionally.
30. Fix the abnormal issue of receiving combat merit rewards after entering the new theater.
31. Other fragmented interface optimization, bug repair, etc.

notes.title: Super benefits, constant surprises, out of print commander is waiting for you

This is the only time of the year, and should not be missed.

First war zone: N · old man

Zone II: SSR Long Leg Hamm

The third war zone: SSR · Jiang Lin

The fourth theater: SSR Catherine

notes.title: New Version Update Announcement
National Day Trailer
notes.content:
Dear Commander Gui'an, the National Day holiday is approaching. In order to make holiday arrangements in advance and have a relaxing and pleasant holiday, the game activity arrangement is as follows:



1. Seven Days of National Day Joy - Go Live: 10.1-10.7 Log in to the game every day to receive the online gift package, and you can also receive the prize lying down. Remember to go online~

2. National Day Seven Day Joy - Holiday Trial: 10.1-10.5 Complete the holiday trial task, receive rich rewards, and give away extra rare props for free~

3. During the National Day, rare skill gift packs and super value material gift packs will be released within a limited time, which can be enjoyed together with other recharge activities. Remember to pay attention to the Capital Bubble!



In case of any activity or game problem, you can contact us through the official QQ group: 588921856 (you can get the gift package code if you enter the group)
